# ankra_proxmox_hosts (Data Source)

The nodes (hosts) of the Proxmox VE cluster behind a credential, for `node` and `placement_nodes` on `ankra_proxmox_cluster`. The counterpart of `ankra cluster proxmox hosts`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_proxmox_hosts" "lab" {
  credential_id = ankra_proxmox_credential.lab.id
}

output "online_hosts" {
  value = [for host in data.ankra_proxmox_hosts.lab.hosts : host.node if host.status == "online"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Credential to read the catalogue through.

### Read-Only

- `hosts` (Attributes List) Proxmox VE nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosts))

<a id="nestedatt--hosts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosts`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_count` (Number) CPU count.
- `memory_bytes` (Number) Memory in bytes.
- `node` (String) Node name.
- `status` (String) Node status, e.g. `online`.
